review.decision: Verify Live capture ownership across binding, status and access changes
review.notes: Use mounted screen entry points, synthetic pane HTTP and both real Chromium layouts. No physical device evidence.

cases.description: Bound transcript validates an observed Live reader
cases.setup: Open, resize and freeze observed Live in a narrow page and a workspace tile.
cases.action: Remove the observation, read a bound transcript for the same session, then change sessions.
cases.expected: The same panel, height and scroll position survive confirmation. A different session cannot inherit the capture.

cases.description: HQ retains the current capture while waiting or idle
cases.setup: Mount the HQ console, load captured terminal rows and expand and resize Live.
cases.action: Enter waiting and idle, then close the reader.
cases.expected: The same scroll view retains the rows and height until manually closed.

cases.description: Pane read authority controls retained captures
cases.setup: Open a populated Live reader using the detail or HQ screen and enter waiting.
cases.action: Return a transient failure, then HTTP 403 or 404 and a later successful pane read.
cases.expected: Transient failure keeps the authorized rows. Rejection clears them and their scroll view. A later authorized read shows fresh rows.
